visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair in a beige hoodie sits at a mahjong table, looking frustrated under dramatic red lighting. She speaks while others' hands move tiles in the foreground. (2) Close-ups of mahjong tiles reveal specific characters and symbols as players draw and discard them. The camera zooms in on the tiles being moved across the table surface. (3) A woman in a denim jacket touches her mahjong-tile earring with a look of intense concentration. Her lip is smudged with a red substance resembling blood. (4) A male player with light-colored hair and facial smudges appears exhausted, hunched over his hand of tiles. The lighting shifts to deep purples and reds, emphasizing his distressed state. (5) A third woman in a white vest looks on with wide eyes and a surprised expression. Quick cuts between all four players' faces heighten the tension as tiles are slammed onto the table. (6) The male player collapses onto his tiles. The woman in the white vest draws a final tile and reveals a winning hand, causing a visual transition to a stylized title card. (7) White text credits roll against a solid black background, listing various contributors and the platform name.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A group of young adults playing mahjong; one woman in a beige hoodie, one in a denim jacket with tile earrings, one in a white vest, and a man in a black suit jacket.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A dimly lit room styled as a dramatic game room or mahjong parlor, with high-contrast red and purple lighting. Some classical-style wall paintings are visible.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, cinematic electronic BGM begins immediately. A female voice speaks with high pitch variability and aggressive tone. Frequent sharp clicking sounds of plastic mahjong tiles hitting the table trigger new phases. (2) A low-pitched impact SFX marks a tile being played. A second female voice enters with a calm, professional narrative tone, punctuated by the rhythmic clacking of the game. (3) A high-pitched 'shimmer' sound effect occurs as the BGM volume dips slightly. Breathiness is audible in the speaker's voice as she whispers about her earring's power. (4) A male voice speaks with significant vocal strain and high intensity, accompanied by a rising synthesizer swell. The sound of a heavy thud follows as he places a tile. (5) Rapid-fire vocal delivery from multiple speakers overlaps with fast-paced rhythmic BGM. Digital UI 'ping' sound effects are inserted during key game moves. (6) A final melodic chime SFX signals the end of the game. The BGM shifts to a more upbeat, celebratory electronic track as the credits roll, with clear articulation in the final spoken lines.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Confrontation -> Supernatural Reveal -> Climax -> Ending Credits
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A stylized, dramatic comedy short film parodying mahjong tropes, where players use supernatural 'god-hand' abilities to compete. It serves as an entertainment piece featuring social media influencers and promoting 17LIVE.
